prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t say one single company is “the best” for everyone — it depends on your needs, budget, and schedule — but I can help you find the best option for your project. A quick plan:

1) Quick questions so I can narrow recommendations
- Is this residential or commercial?
- Whole house or a few rooms / one floor?
- Any tight timeline?
- Budget range or quality preference (economy vs. premium)?
- Do you want color consultation, eco‑friendly paints, or furniture moving?

2) How to find top local painters in St. Louis
- Search Google Maps and sort by rating + read recent reviews.
- Check Yelp, Angi (formerly Angie’s List), Nextdoor, and the Better Business Bureau.
- Ask neighborhood Facebook groups or friends/family for referrals — photos from a nearby home are most useful.
- Look for painters who advertise local references and show before/after photos.

3) What to require from any company before you hire
- Proof of insurance (general liability and, if they have crew, workers’ comp).
- Written, line‑item estimate (prep, number of coats, paint brand/finish, cleanup).
- Timeline and start/completion dates in writing.
- Warranty on workmanship and paint.
- References and recent project photos; ask to see at least 2 recent local jobs.
- Ask if they will use premium paints or allow you to supply paint, and whether caulking/patching is included.

4) Red flags
- Demand for full payment up front.
- Very low bids with no written details.
- No license/insurance or unwillingness to provide references.
- Poor or no contract.

If you’d like, give me your zip code and answers to the questions above and I’ll list highly rated painters in the St. Louis area and what to ask each (I can’t browse in this chat, but I can tell you exact search phrases and filters to use and a template email/phone script to vet them). Which would you prefer?
